description: This is a standalone PHP script designed for performing silent upgrades of a SuiteCRM instance. It handles upgrade preparations, running pre- and post-install scripts, merging configuration settings, updating database relationships, managing caches, and registering upgrade history, all via command-line interface. Its key functions include verifying arguments, preparing the system, clearing caches, checking and updating configuration, handling files and database relationships, and executing the upgrade process step by step.

methods.name: prepSystemForUpgradeSilent
methods.description: Prepares necessary directories for upgrade by creating them if they do not exist.

methods.name: clearCacheSU
methods.description: Recursively deletes files with a specific extension from a given directory.

methods.name: checkConfigForPermissions
methods.description: Checks and adds default permissions to the config file if missing.

methods.name: checkLoggerSettings
methods.description: Ensures logging configuration exists in the config file, adding defaults if necessary.

methods.name: checkLeadConversionSettings
methods.description: Checks and sets default lead conversion activity options in configuration.

methods.name: checkResourceSettings
methods.description: Ensures resource management settings are defined in configuration.

methods.name: createMissingRels
methods.description: Creates missing database relationship entries for standard modules.

methods.name: merge_passwordsetting
methods.description: Merges default password settings into the configuration array.

methods.name: addDefaultModuleRoles
methods.description: Adds default access roles for modules if not already present.

methods.name: verifyArguments
methods.description: Validates and processes command line arguments for the upgrade script.

methods.name: threeWayMerge
methods.description: Placeholder for three-way merge operations during upgrade.

methods.name: repairTableDictionaryExtFile
methods.description: Fixes extension table dictionary files by removing entries with missing files.
